name: gen-L3-02 throw catch finally
code:
log = []
def g():
    try:
        yield "pause"
    except ValueError as e:
        log.append(("caught", type(e).__name__, e.args[0]))
        yield "recovered"
    finally:
        log.append("finally")
it = g()
next(it)
log.append(("throw-return", it.throw(ValueError("boom"))))
try:
    next(it)
except StopIteration:
    log.append("done")
print(log)

name: gen-L3-03 close GeneratorExit finally
code:
log = []
def g():
    try:
        yield "pause"
    except GeneratorExit:
        log.append("caught")
        raise
    finally:
        log.append("finally")
it = g()
next(it)
it.close()
log.append("closed")
print(log)
